title: JSON Tokenizer
description: Write a Zig program that tokenizes a simple JSON string into its structural elements (brackets, colons, strings, numbers).
hints: Tokenize by iterating character by character and identifying token types
Use `switch` with multiple cases and ranges for character matching
Strings start and end with `'"'` — skim past their content
Comptime string escape: `\"` in Zig source represents a literal double quote
